name: Climate Change Adaptation: From Theory to Practice
description: Offered through the school of public policy, this course introduces students to the policy dimensions of climate change adaptation. It covers key concepts—risk, vulnerability, resilience—and explores how adaptation strategies are developed and implemented across sectors and governance levels. Emphasizing real-world challenges, the course examines policy tools, planning frameworks, and financing mechanisms that shape adaptation outcomes. Through case studies and applied assignments, students will analyze barriers, assess interventions, and engage with justice and equity in decision-making. The course prepares students to critically evaluate and contribute to effective, inclusive, and context-specific adaptation policy and practice.
